sentences.en: And they march into the village.
sentences.zh: 他们行军进入村庄。

sentences.en: And I guess you've got to say that this is vengeance for what Peter the Great did to the Garden of John Evelyn when he arrived with his lads and trashed it with wheelbarrow races and demolished all the hedges.
sentences.zh: 我想你得说，这是对彼得大帝当年带着他的小伙子们来到约翰·埃弗林的园林，用独轮车比赛把它毁掉并拆毁所有树篱的行为的复仇。

sentences.en: So, you know, what goes around comes around.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

sentences.en: Anyway, Balaclava is transformed from this picturesque village into the great hub that is joining the Royal Navy to the British Army.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，巴拉克拉瓦从这个风景如画的村庄变成了连接皇家海军与英国陆军的大枢纽。

sentences.en: And because it's so important, Raglan does assign men to its defense, but no more than 5,000.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此重要，拉格兰确实派人防守，但人数不超过五千人。

sentences.en: And that's because by this point, the British Army is pretty depleted.
sentences.zh: 那是因为到这个时候，英国陆军已经所剩无几了。

sentences.en: You know, the dysentery is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，痢疾一直在持续。

sentences.en: And so, if the siege is to be prosecuted, he needs to commit most of his men to that.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果要继续进行围城战，他必须将大部分兵力投入其中。

sentences.en: So, 20,000 men are committed to the siege of Sebastopol, 5,000 to the protection of Balaclava, which is eight miles away by road.
sentences.zh: 所以，两万人投入塞瓦斯托波尔围城战，五千人用于保护通过公路距离八英里远的巴拉克拉瓦。

sentences.en: Now, I said that communications between Balaclava and Sebastopol are challenging.
sentences.zh: 刚才我说了，巴拉克拉瓦和塞瓦斯托波尔之间的交通充满挑战。

sentences.en: And this really matters because without supplies, the British Army can't really continue to prosecute the siege.
sentences.zh: 这真的很重要，因为没有补给，英国陆军无法真正继续进行围城战。

sentences.en: So, why are they so bad?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么情况这么糟糕呢？

sentences.en: Basically, there's no telegraph, there's no railway, and there's just one metalled road.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这里没有电报，没有铁路，只有一条铺面公路。

sentences.en: And this is called the Voranzoff Road.
sentences.zh: 这就叫做沃龙佐夫路。

sentences.en: And it runs along heights which stretch behind Balaclava.
sentences.zh: 它沿着巴拉克拉瓦背后的高地延伸。

sentences.en: And it can only be reached via what are kind of very rough tracks.
sentences.zh: 而且只能通过某种非常崎岖的小路才能到达。

sentences.en: And these tracks, as the autumn rains come, are going to become very slippery and muddy.
sentences.zh: 随着秋雨来临，这些小路将会变得非常湿滑和泥泞。

sentences.en: And so, the defense of the Voranzoff Road is really crucial.
sentences.zh: 因此，沃龙佐夫路的防守至关重要。

sentences.en: They need to keep this one metalled road under their control.
sentences.zh: 他们需要将这条铺面公路控制在自己手中。

sentences.en: Because otherwise, it will be really, really difficult to get supplies to Sebastopol, because then the British would be entirely dependent upon muddy tracks.
sentences.zh: 否则，将补给运送到塞瓦斯托波尔将变得非常非常困难，因为那样英国人将完全依赖泥泞的小路。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Now, Raglan doesn't really have men to protect this ridge, to protect the line of the Voranzoff Road.
sentences.zh: 现在，拉格兰实际上没有足够的人手来保护这条山脊，保护沃龙佐夫路的防线。

sentences.en: And so, instead, they try and kind of skimp on it, and they dig some redoubts.
sentences.zh: 所以相反，他们试图在这上面偷工减料，修筑了一些堡垒。

sentences.en: Redoubts?
sentences.zh: 堡垒？

sentences.en: Not just one redoubts, but six redoubts.
sentences.zh: 不只是一个堡垒，而是六个堡垒。

sentences.en: We've got redoubts back on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目又出现堡垒了。

sentences.en: And they get guns from the Royal Navy ships that are in the Bay of Balaclava.
sentences.zh: 他们从巴拉克拉瓦湾的皇家海军舰艇上搬下大炮。

sentences.en: And they wheel them up, and they put them in these redoubts, and they station a thousand
sentences.zh: 把它们用轮子推上来，放在这些堡垒里，并驻扎了一千名

sentences.en: Turkish soldiers to man them under the command of British artillery officers.
sentences.zh: 土耳其士兵在英国炮兵军官的指挥下驻守。

sentences.en: Have you noticed how redoubts only ever appear on the show in the context of Russia?
sentences.zh: 你有没有注意到，节目中出现堡垒总是跟俄国有关？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, there's something about it, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这其中一定有什么原因，对吧？

sentences.en: You need it.
sentences.zh: 你需要它。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But the Royal Navy can only spare enough guns for four of these redoubts.
sentences.zh: 但皇家海军只能腾出足够装备四个堡垒的大炮。

sentences.en: So, two of the redoubts don't even have any guns.
sentences.zh: 所以其中两个堡垒甚至没有大炮。

sentences.en: They're useless, in other words, presumably.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，它们大概毫无用处。

sentences.en: Nah, they're not useless.
sentences.zh: 不，它们并非毫无用处。

sentences.en: But they're not going to stop a full-blooded Russian attack.
sentences.zh: 但它们挡不住全力以赴的俄军进攻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's the problem.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: But I guess Raglan's hope is that Russian spies will see that there are redoubts, that there are guns in them, and they won't try and attack them.
sentences.zh: 不过我想拉格兰的希望是，俄国间谍会看到有堡垒，里面有大炮，于是就不会试图攻击它们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: What about the quality of men in the redoubts?
sentences.zh: 堡垒里的人员素质如何？

sentences.en: The Turkish garrisons.
sentences.zh: 土耳其守军。

sentences.en: The British are inevitably slightly contemptuous of the Turkish soldiers.
sentences.zh: 英国人难免对土耳其士兵有点轻蔑。

sentences.en: But the Turkish soldiers are going to more than prove their mettle, actually.
sentences.zh: 但土耳其士兵实际上将充分证明他们的实力。

sentences.en: They're going to put up a good show.
sentences.zh: 他们会有出色的表现。

sentences.en: That's spoiler alert that they are going to get attacked.
sentences.zh: 剧透一下，他们将会遭到攻击。

sentences.en: Anyway, so you've got this ridge of heights as a kind of natural barrier.
sentences.zh: 总之，你们有一道高地作为天然屏障。

sentences.en: Screening Balaclava from any possible Russian attack.
sentences.zh: 把巴拉克拉瓦挡在任何可能的俄军进攻之外。

sentences.en: And south of these heights, the Causeway Heights, there's a valley.
sentences.zh: 在这片高地——考斯韦高地的南面，有一条山谷。

sentences.en: And in this valley, Cardigan posts the cavalry, which includes the Light Brigade, of course,
sentences.zh: 在这条山谷里，卡迪根部署了骑兵，其中自然包括轻骑兵旅，

sentences.en: but also by this point, the Heavy Brigade, because they've arrived in Balaclava shortly after its capture by the British.
sentences.zh: 但到这个时候，重骑兵旅也加入了，因为他们在英军攻占巴拉克拉瓦后不久就抵达了这里。

sentences.en: So the full complement of brigades is now present.
sentences.zh: 所以现在各骑兵旅已全部到齐。

sentences.en: And conditions for the cavalry are not pleasant.
sentences.zh: 骑兵们的环境可不怎么舒适。

sentences.en: So we've said they haven't really brought tents that are suitable for winter conditions, only summer conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们前面说过，他们其实没带适合冬天过冬的帐篷，只带了夏天的。

sentences.en: And these are the ones that they're having to use.
sentences.zh: 而现在他们只能将就着用这些。

sentences.en: And mid-October, it's starting to get quite chilly by night in the Crimea.
sentences.zh: 到了十月中旬，克里米亚的夜晚已经开始变得相当寒冷了。

sentences.en: And adding to the fun, there's a general lack of kind of forage and fodder for the horses.
sentences.zh: 更要命的是，马匹的草料和饲料普遍短缺。

sentences.en: So morale isn't great.
sentences.zh: 所以士气实在高不到哪去。

sentences.en: And Lucan, in his attempt to cheer his men up, does it in the way he knows best, namely by waking them all up before dawn every morning and having them stand a horse, often for an
sentences.zh: 卢肯为了让手下打起精神，使出了他最拿手的绝活：每天天亮前把所有人叫醒，让他们骑在马上待命，通常是一小时甚至更久。

sentences.en: hour or more.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说可真是太欢乐了。

sentences.en: So that's great fun for them.
sentences.zh: 没错，棒极了。

sentences.en: Yeah, brilliant.
sentences.zh: 好极了。

sentences.en: And on top of this, the cavalry is still not allowed to go reconnoitering and possibly having a go at the Cossacks or whatever.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，骑兵仍然不准去侦察，或者去骚扰哥萨克人什么的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because Raglan, you know, he wants to keep them safe.
sentences.zh: 因为拉格兰你知道的，他想确保他们的安全。

sentences.en: And so Lord Lucan, you know, he keeps his nickname.
sentences.zh: 所以卢肯勋爵，你知道的，他保住了自己的绰号。

sentences.en: For Lord Cardigan, who's used to the comforts of the Café de Paris and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 至于习惯了巴黎咖啡馆等舒适环境的卡迪根勋爵……

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, this must be tremendous hardship for him to be roughing it alongside his men, to be sharing the sort of rough straw beds.
sentences.zh: 我是说，对他而言，和手下一起吃苦、睡在那种粗糙的稻草床上，一定是一场巨大的磨难。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The vermin, the mud.
sentences.zh: 还有害虫和烂泥。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The mud, the vermin, the cold.
sentences.zh: 烂泥、害虫和严寒。

sentences.en: But fair play to him for putting up with this and for showing the world that he's not just a pampered fop and he is actually one of the boys after all.
sentences.zh: 不过话说回来，他能忍受这一切，并向世人证明自己不只是个娇生惯养的花花公子，而是真正能和大家打成一片，这也算他做得公正。

sentences.en: But Dominic, Cardigan is not with his men.
sentences.zh: 但是多米尼克，卡迪根可没跟他的手下在一起。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，没有吗？

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Do you know where he is?
sentences.zh: 你知道他在哪儿吗？

sentences.en: He's not sharing their privations like a true commander.
sentences.zh: 他根本没有像个真正的指挥官那样和士兵们同甘共苦。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: He's on his yacht.
sentences.zh: 他在他的游艇上。

sentences.en: He's literally on his yacht.
sentences.zh: 他 literalmente 就在他的游艇上。

sentences.en: Oh, brilliant.
sentences.zh: 哦，太妙了。

sentences.en: Because this had arrived in Balaclava Harbour on the 13th of October.
sentences.zh: 因为这艘船是在10月13日抵达巴拉克拉瓦港的。

sentences.en: And it's a very slim, elegant vessel called the Dryad.
sentences.zh: 这是一艘非常修长、优雅的船，名叫“森林仙女”号（Dryad）。

sentences.en: And by day, to give Cardigan credit, you know, he is with his men.
sentences.zh: 说句公道话，白天的时候，卡迪根确实和手下在一起。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He rides up from his yacht, puts his men through his paces.
sentences.zh: 他从游艇上骑马赶来，监督手下进行训练。

sentences.en: And then he goes riding with a pal of his, one of his brothers-in-law, who's arrived from London.
sentences.zh: 然后他会和他的一个朋友、从伦敦来的连襟去骑马兜风。

sentences.en: And this is a chap called Mr. De Burr, Hubert De Burr.
sentences.zh: 这人叫德伯尔先生，于贝尔·德伯尔。

sentences.en: And he's described by Russell, the Times correspondent, as an unlovely gentleman known to the London world as the squire.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》战地记者拉塞尔对他的评价是：一个伦敦上流社会人称“乡绅”的不讨喜的绅士。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪。

sentences.en: The squire's turned up.
sentences.zh: 乡绅登场了。

sentences.en: Oh, tremendous banter.
sentences.zh: 哦，这玩笑开得真大。

sentences.en: Russell transcribed some of their dialogue.
sentences.zh: 拉塞尔记录了他们的一些对话。

sentences.en: And De Burr, like Cardigan, is a great man for going, ho, ho, ho.
sentences.zh: 德伯尔和卡迪根一样，特别喜欢“哈哈哈”地大笑。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪。

sentences.en: Cardigan rides up to the siege positions and says, I don't think this siege is going very well, do you, squire?
sentences.zh: 卡迪根骑马到围城阵地前说：“我觉得这场围城战进展得不太顺利，你说呢，乡绅？”

sentences.en: Ho, ho, ho.
sentences.zh: 哈哈哈。

sentences.en: How their men must cheer them.
sentences.zh: 他们的手下一定在心里为他们欢呼吧。

sentences.en: Well, the thing is, Cardigan's right.
sentences.zh: 问题是，卡迪根说得没错。

sentences.en: The siege position, you know, and it's not actually great.
sentences.zh: 围城阵地那里的情况，你知道的，确实不怎么好。

sentences.en: But it's not great for Cardigan's reputation either.
sentences.zh: 但对卡迪根的名声来说同样好不到哪去。

sentences.en: Are he and the squire dining on army rations?
sentences.zh: 他和乡绅在吃军队的口粮吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 并没有。

sentences.en: They've got a French chef on their yacht.
sentences.zh: 他们的游艇上请了法国厨师。

sentences.en: So every evening, the squire and Lord Cardigan retire to the yacht and dine on pate.
sentences.zh: 所以每天晚上，乡绅和卡迪根勋爵都会回到游艇上吃肉酱。

sentences.en: I want to hear more about the squire.
sentences.zh: 我想听听更多关于乡绅的事。

sentences.en: He sounds tremendous.
sentences.zh: 听起来他是个妙人。

sentences.en: He's a legend.
sentences.zh: 他是个传奇。

sentences.en: He's an absolute legend.
sentences.zh: 绝对的传奇。

sentences.en: Absolute ledge.
sentences.zh: 绝对的大牛。

sentences.en: Bloody top bloke.
sentences.zh: 真是个顶天立地的好哥们。

sentences.en: He really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And they have feather beds on board the yacht.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的游艇上还有羽毛床。

sentences.en: So, you know, I mean, it's not bad.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，这日子过得还不错。

sentences.en: And obviously, it's terrible for Cardigan's reputation among the men.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，这极大地损害了卡迪根在士兵中的声誉。

sentences.en: And Captain Nolan, he thinks this is awful.
sentences.zh: 诺兰上尉觉得这太糟糕了。

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然啦。

sentences.en: He's been calling Luke and Lord look on.
sentences.zh: 他一直管卢肯叫“当心勋爵”。

sentences.en: He calls Cardigan the noble yachtsman.
sentences.zh: 他管卡迪根叫“高贵的游艇船主”。

sentences.en: That's very good, actually.
sentences.zh: 这外号起得真好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there's another officer who's a captain of the Light Dragoons.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个军官，是轻龙骑兵的一个上尉。

sentences.en: And he says, Cardigan, you know, he's got as much brains as my boot.
sentences.zh: 他说：“卡迪根这脑子，也就跟我靴子里的智商差不多。”

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: But is this fair?
sentences.zh: 不过这话公平吗？

sentences.en: Time will tell.
sentences.zh: 拭目以待吧。

sentences.en: Because on the 18th of October, it is noted by scouts that a sizable Russian force is starting to gather beyond the Causeway Heights.
sentences.zh: 因为在10月18日，侦察兵发现一支规模不小的俄军开始在考斯韦高地外围集结。

sentences.en: And the obvious thing to do would have been to send the Light Cavalry to scare them off.
sentences.zh: 当时显而易见的做法应该是派轻骑兵去把他们吓跑。

sentences.en: But Raglan, as ever, he's short of men.
sentences.zh: 但拉格兰一如既往地人手短缺。

sentences.en: He doesn't want to use his cavalry.
sentences.zh: 他不想动用他的骑兵。

sentences.en: He refuses to go on the offensive against these gathering bands of Russian soldiers.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝主动出击去攻击这些集结中的俄军部队。

sentences.en: And so the days pass.
sentences.zh: 于是日子一天天过去。

sentences.en: And more and more Russian reinforcements are taking up position beyond the Causeway Heights.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的俄国增援部队在考斯韦高地外围占据了阵地。

sentences.en: And by the 24th of October, there is an entire army in position beyond the Causeway Heights.
sentences.zh: 到了10月24日，考斯韦高地外围已经部署了一整支军队。

sentences.en: 25,000 men, infantry, cavalry, and 78 guns.
sentences.zh: 2万5千名士兵、步兵、骑兵，还有78门火炮。

sentences.en: And its purpose is, by this point, very clear.
sentences.zh: 到了这个时候，他们的意图已经非常明显了。

sentences.en: The Russians are gearing up for an attack on Balaclava.
sentences.zh: 俄国人正在厉兵秣马，准备进攻巴拉克拉瓦。

sentences.en: Because to reiterate, if the Russians can capture Balaclava, then the British siege lines around Sebastopol will be cut off from the outside world.
sentences.zh: 因为重申一遍，如果俄国人占领了巴拉克拉瓦，那么塞瓦斯托波尔周围的英军围城防线就会与外界切断。

sentences.en: And effectively, the siege will be done.
sentences.zh: 实际上，围城战也将宣告结束。

sentences.en: And sure enough, before dawn on the 25th of October, the men of the Heavy and Light Brigades have been at horse.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，在10月25日天亮之前，重骑兵旅和轻骑兵旅的士兵们就已经上马待命了。

sentences.en: They are now dismissed.
sentences.zh: 现在他们解散了。

sentences.en: So they're going back to their quarters.
sentences.zh: 于是他们正返回各自的营房。

sentences.en: Lord Lucan is riding with his staff along the bottom of the Causeway Heights.
sentences.zh: 卢肯勋爵正带着参谋人员沿着考斯韦高地的底部骑马巡视。

sentences.en: And Lord Cardigan is fast asleep on his yacht.
sentences.zh: 而卡迪根勋爵则在自己的游艇上呼呼大睡。

sentences.en: And suddenly, there comes this massive crash.
sentences.zh: 突然，传来了一声巨大的轰鸣。

sentences.en: And it is the sound of guns firing from one of the redoubts on the Causeway Heights.
sentences.zh: 那是来自考斯韦高地其中一个棱堡的炮火声。

sentences.en: And it is clear that the Battle of Balaclava has begun.
sentences.zh: 很显然，巴拉克拉瓦战役已经打响了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: What a cliffhanger.
sentences.zh: 真是个巨大的悬念。

sentences.en: So ahead lies the thrilling climax of this series.
sentences.zh: 接下来就是本系列激动人心的最高潮。

sentences.en: As we get, at last, to the charge of the Heavy Brigade, the stand of the thin red line, and, of course, the charge of the Light Brigade,
sentences.zh: 我们终于要迎来重骑兵旅冲锋、红线阵的坚守，当然，还有轻骑兵旅的冲锋，

sentences.en: one of the most celebrated moments in British history.
sentences.zh: 这是英国历史上最著名的时刻之一。

sentences.en: Now, if you're a member of the Rest is History Club, you can hear that episode right away.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你是“历史就是这样”俱乐部的会员，你马上就能收听到那一集节目。

sentences.en: And if you're at all tempted to become a member of the Rest is History Club, it is worth reminding you that Christmas is coming, so it could be a lovely treat for yourself,
sentences.zh: 如果你有一点点心动想成为“历史就是这样”俱乐部的会员，值得提醒你的是圣诞节就要到了，这可以作为送给自己的一份精美礼物，

sentences.en: or for your loved ones, or for your enemies, whoever you, you know, you choose.
sentences.zh: 或者送给你的挚爱，或者送给你的仇敌，随你喜欢，由你挑选。

sentences.en: Now, Aaliyah, our producer, who I remind you is a massive fan of Captain Nolan, of his cavalry books, and of woke horsemanship generally, she has asked me to make it clear to you
sentences.zh: 现在，我们的制作人阿莉娅——我提醒大家她可是诺兰上尉、他的骑兵著作以及清醒马术的狂热粉丝——她让我向大家澄清一点：

sentences.en: that you can only access these by going to the website, therestishistory.com, and clicking on the word GIFTS.
sentences.zh: 你只能通过访问网站 therestishistory.com 并点击“礼品”（GIFTS）这个词来获取这些内容。

sentences.zh: 不要点别的东西，因为那不会带你到礼品页面。

sentences.zh: 你必须点击“礼品”这个词。

sentences.en: But to give you an indication of the kind of people who are members of the Rest is History Club, when Tom was describing the Squire, I thought to myself,
sentences.zh: 但为了让你对“历史就是这样”俱乐部的会员都是些什么样的人有个概念，当汤姆在描述乡绅时，我在心里想：

sentences.en: we have thousands of people like the Squire on our yacht,
sentences.zh: 我们的游艇上就有成千上万个像乡绅这样的人，

sentences.en: cruising off the Black Sea coaSt.
sentences.zh: 在黑海海岸附近巡航。

sentences.en: So these are the kind of people you'd be hanging around with, absolute legends, bloody good blokes, and some ladies.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是你会与之结交的人，绝对的传奇，顶好的好哥们，还有一些女士。

sentences.en: And you can get this by going to GIFTS at therestishistory.com, and I genuinely cannot recommend it too highly.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过访问 therestishistory.com 上的“礼品”来获得这一切，我真的极力推荐。

sentences.en: So, on that bombshell, well, there are many more bombshells to come, because next time, it's the Charge of the Light Brigade.
sentences.zh: 带着这个重磅消息——好吧，后面还有更多重磅消息，因为下一次讲的就是轻骑兵旅冲锋。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Tom, and goodbye.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢汤姆，再见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: It's Dominic here.
sentences.zh: 我是多米尼克。

sentences.en: The story couldn't be more excitingly poised, could it?
sentences.zh: 这个故事的悬念可谓扣人心弦，不是吗？

sentences.zh: 卢肯勋爵、拉格兰勋爵、

sentences.en: Lord Cardigan, and our friend the Squire are on the brink of the Charge of the Light Brigade, one of the most exciting moments in British military history.
sentences.zh: 卡迪根勋爵以及我们的朋友乡绅正处于轻骑兵旅冲锋的边缘，这是英国军事史上最激动人心的时刻之一。

sentences.en: Of course, one of the most disastrous as well.
sentences.zh: 当然，也是最灾难性的时刻之一。

sentences.en: But before you return to the valleys of Crimea, what about a quick detour onto the high seas?
sentences.zh: 但在你重返克里米亚山谷之前，何不来一次公海上的短暂漫游呢？

sentences.en: Because on our sister podcast, the book club, presented by me and by Tabitha Syrett, we have ventured slightly further back in time to the Napoleonic Wars
sentences.zh: 因为在我们的姊妹播客《书友会》中，由我和塔比莎·西雷特主持，我们把时间稍微往前拨回到了拿破仑战争时期，

sentences.en: and to the Royal Navy's campaign against the tyrant Bonaparte.
sentences.zh: 以及英国皇家海军讨伐暴君波拿巴的战役。

sentences.en: Because in this week's episode of the book club, we're looking at the book that a lot of people think kick-started the greatest series of historical novels ever written.
sentences.zh: 因为在本周的《书友会》节目中，我们正在探讨那本被许多人认为开创了有史以来最伟大历史小说系列的著作。

sentences.en: It's Patrick O'Brien's
sentences.zh: 这就是帕特里克·奥布莱恩的

sentences.en: Master and Commander.
sentences.zh: 《怒海争锋》。

sentences.en: And as many of you will know, it follows the adventures of a group of Royal Navy officers and men at the dawn of the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 正如你们许多人所知，它讲述了19世纪初一群皇家海军军官和水兵的冒险经历。

sentences.en: Above all, our heroes,
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，我们的英雄们，

sentences.en: Jack Aubrey and his great friend,
sentences.zh: 杰克·奥布瑞和他最好的朋友，

sentences.en: Stephen Machuin.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·马图林。

sentences.en: Now, loads of you I know will have seen the film,
sentences.zh: 我知道你们中间很多人都看过这部电影，

sentences.en: Master and Commander of the Peter Weir film from 2003.
sentences.zh: 彼得·威尔2003年导演的电影《怒海争锋》。

sentences.en: Brilliant, brilliant film.
sentences.zh: 一部极其精彩的电影。

sentences.en: And in the episode, we talk about the differences between the books and the film.
sentences.zh: 在节目中，我们讨论了书本与电影之间的差异。

sentences.en: We talk about the origins of the books, the real life history behind them.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了这些书籍的起源，以及它们背后的真实历史。

sentences.en: I do an excellent Russell Crowe.
sentences.zh: 我模仿的罗素·克劳可棒了。

sentences.en: It is a deep dive into this most sumptuous of historical fictional treats.
sentences.zh: 这是一次对这场最丰盛的历史虚构文学盛宴的深度剖析。

sentences.zh: 所以，如果你有一点心动，那就去
